title: Phyllis’ Wedding
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Phyllis gets married with Michael participating in her wedding. The event includes surprises such as Phyllis' father walking her down the aisle and Michael making humorous speeches. Jim shows interest in wedding crashers, and Dwight questions Phyllis about wedding details, showing suspicion. The episode concludes with the wedding ceremony, celebrations, and Michael expressing his good wishes for Phyllis and Bob.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Phyllis is getting married. And I am in the wedding party.
Phyllis: Yes, I put Michael in my wedding.
Priest: And do you, Phyllis, take Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration, to be your lawfully wedded husband?
Michael: Ladies and Gentleman, for the first time as a couple, Mr. and Mrs. Bob Vance.
Michael: Congratulations, Bob. You're a good man. But just know… if you ever lay a finger on Phyllis, I will kill you.
Michael: Agreed. No fingers will be laid on Phyllis.
Jim: You know I just wish, I wish, I had the investigative powers to smoke some of these guys out.
Dwight: Once again, Jim, I will take care of this. I will locate the wedding crashers and report them to Phyllis.
